why: Quest asked for construction materials on the front page and has no photography of its own of them — Quest photographs jobs, not stock. These are the only photographs on the site Quest did not take. There were four; the hero was rebuilt on Quest's own photography and took two of them with it.
rule: CC0 only. Public-domain dedication: commercial use permitted, no attribution required, no share-alike. Anything added here must carry the same, and build/lib/images.test.mjs enforces that every non-Quest image in the tree is listed in this file.

rejected.why: Terracotta roof tiles with KERALA TILES and JOHN'S TILE WORKS cast into their faces. Another firm's name on Quest's front page, which is the same rule that ruled out six of the seven machine cut-outs in assets/cut/.

retired.why: Removed from the tree, not merely unreferenced. Both existed only to build the old home hero — a frameless cut-out object standing on an accent plane, with a block texture as the plane's ground. That hero is gone: the front page is a full-bleed photograph of a Quest jobsite now, on the same construction as every other page's banner. Nothing else ever used either file.
retired.rule: These files must stay out of assets/. mat/kit.webp in particular: its rights were NOT VERIFIED and never became verified. It was supplied by Quest as a Downloads file with no licence metadata and it looks like commercial stock. It is no longer a live question, and reinstating it would make it one again. images.test.mjs fails if either reappears.
